rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for working together toward a shared purpose or benefit.

example.english: We need to cooperate to complete this plan.
example.traditional: 我哋要合作先可以完成呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hap6 zok3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gai2 waak6

rows.note: Use this casual phrase when the cooperation means literally doing a task together.

example.english: Today we will cooperate by doing the work together, and it will be much faster.
example.traditional: 今日我哋一齊做嘢，快好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zou6 je5 faai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when people, actions, or systems need to coordinate smoothly or fit in with one another.

example.english: You two cooperate really well, so the event went smoothly.
example.traditional: 你哋兩個配合得幾好，個活動先至咁順利。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 pui3 hap6 dak1 gei2 hou2 go3 wut6 dung6 sin1 zi3 gam3 seon6 lei6
